'''Handy''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugation]] of Cloud City by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Handy was truanting from [[school]] with his friend, [[Allania Jakien]] in the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] tunnels. While attempting to reach their parents, the pair came across a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] patrol. Handy was caught by one, to which he responded by kicking the stormtrooper in the face.
